name: moody-purple-selfie
image_purpose: colored lighting, hair, phone, and bedroom atmosphere reference

prompt.project_info: Create a vertical photorealistic bedroom selfie of an approved adult woman in moody purple-blue light.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long dual-toned platinum and dark hair, blue-grey eyes, silver hoops, silver bracelet, white opaque sleeveless top, and black opaque lounge shorts.
prompt.composition_elements: Seated or side-lying comfortably on a bed with white sheets and plush bunny/cat toys nearby, holding a smartphone, pouty expression, face and upper body clear, no rear-body emphasis.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Cool purple and blue ambient light with phone-screen fill on the face, dreamy bedroom mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone selfie, portrait 9:16, natural skin texture, sharp face and eyes, realistic low-light detail.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Approved adult woman with platinum-and-dark long hair takes a relaxed vertical bedroom selfie while seated or lying on her side on a white bed, wearing a white opaque top and black opaque lounge shorts. Include plush bunny and cat toys, purple-blue ambient light, phone-screen glow, natural skin, and a playful pout. No bikini or rear-body emphasis.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, bikini bottom, string bottoms, exposed underwear, face-down provocative pose, sexualized body emphasis, nudity, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, watermark, public figure likeness.
